description: Found during the fz-k22.10 spike. Running the SAME compiled binary for enum_predicate_search 3 times produced 3 DIFFERENT failure messages -- the affected producer materialization is schedule-dependent / non-deterministic. Per the campaigns rule (tiny-fixture slowness/instability = correctness), non-determinism here is a real correctness signal (a non-monotone join or unordered iteration in the callable/boundary materialization path), not flakiness to tolerate. Isolate via repeated runs + --log-telemetry diff; likely a HashMap-iteration-order or schedule-order dependence in the callable_for_producer / fallback_callable_boundary / materialize_transport_value path surfaced by the multi-resolution case. Blocks trusting any run/build result for enum_predicate_search until deterministic. Relates to fz-k22.10 (Bug A) and the new Bug B.

comments.text: SAME ROOT as fz-k22.10: the non-determinism is the 'arbitrary survivor' in semantic.rs CallSiteSummary coalescing (merge_callsite_activation discards a divergent arrow; which one survives depends on observation/HashMap order). Fixing fz-k22.10 (key coalescing by full ActivationKey, no arbitrary discard) should make it deterministic by construction. Verify determinism is restored when fz-k22.10 lands; likely closes as a dup.

RE-SCOPED (fz-k22.10 option-B spike): the enum_predicate_search whole-fixture non-determinism is NOT the CallSiteSummary arbitrary-side-pick -- it is present IDENTICALLY in the be54e0126 baseline and persists after the coalescing recompute. It traces to Ty-interning / scheduling order UPSTREAM in the pipeline (callable/entry-id numbering + which cranelift instruction fails vary run to run). The coalescing merge order-independence IS now closed (unit-tested), but that was a different, narrower arbitrariness. This ticket's real target is the upstream Ty-interning/scheduling nondeterminism. Violates the north-star 'graph deterministic given the root'.

LOCALIZED AND PROVEN width-relevant (fz-k22.10 spike 5): the nondeterminism IS the order-dependent width-blind merge in CallSiteSummary coalescing -- kept/discarded flip direction run-to-run AND within one run at the recursive reducer callsite (FnId 203 callsite 0 -> FnId 176). Which sid crashes (149/140/none) tracks the survivor. Fixing the merge to a width-aware deterministic join (fz-k22.10 fix part a) closes this.

SECOND ENTRY POINT MEASURED (spike 5 final): ground_surface_for_template_in_session (runtime_demand.rs:2834+) resolves template surfaces by FIRST MATCH over HashSet iteration order of demanded executables -- probe counted 1300-1600 genuinely ambiguous multi-candidate picks PER RUN (template_ground_AMBIGUOUS). Together with the width-blind CallSiteSummary merge (the other proven source), these two decide which activations get minted/resolved/paired per run -- why the crash offender varies (sid149 / sid183 / none). FIX: both sources must become deterministic functions of demand -- (a) width-aware deterministic join in coalescing (with fz-k22.16), (b) template grounding must not first-match over unordered iteration: require agreement across candidates, pick by a deterministic demand-derived key, or wait until the demanded answer is unique (pull-correct).

title: fz-k22: enum_predicate_search producer materialization is non-deterministic across runs (3 different failure messages in 3 runs of the same binary)
